label: Living Room

checks.label: Reverberation
checks.reason: Mid RT60 (500 Hz-1 kHz) 1.99 s, outside the workable range (<= 0.6 s).

treatment.reason: To bring mid RT60 from 1.99 s to 0.40 s, add about 24.8 m2 of absorption: roughly 29.3 m2 of panels (41 panels), covering 25% of the room's surfaces.
assumptions: Panels absorb 0.9 at 500 Hz-1 kHz and are 0.72 m2 each (0.6 x 1.2 m); typical values, not a specific product.
Panels mainly control mid and high frequencies; low-frequency decay needs bass traps.

Room is assumed empty; furniture, rugs and treatment would lower RT60.
Rooms are treated as an equivalent rectangular box.
missing: Outside noise and sound isolation are not assessed here; see the nearby noise sources panel.
HVAC, plumbing and neighbour noise are unknown.
Door, window and opening positions are unknown.
method: Rule-based fit from the modeled acoustic report: each use case checks mid RT60, size and bass-mode spacing against editable thresholds. Qualitative, not a measurement or a score.
